record.paper_title: Some of my favorite open problems
record.original_question: Under the same assumptions as in q_008, consider the variational problem inf{E(u): u∈H^1_g(Ω;S^2)∩C(Ω̄)} with E(u)=∫_Ω|∇u|^2. Is this infimum attained by some continuous map?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 4.2 ([40, 41]). Is the (4.7) Inf{ E(u): u ∈ H1_g(Ω; S2) ∩ C(Ω̄) } achieved?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ be a bounded smooth domain and let $g : \partial\Omega \to S^2$ be a smooth boundary datum, where $S^2 \subset \mathbb{R}^3$ denotes the unit sphere. Define the constrained Sobolev space
$$H^1_g(\Omega; S^2) = \{ u \in H^1(\Omega; \mathbb{R}^3) : u(x) \in S^2 \text{ for a.e. } x \in \Omega,\ u|_{\partial\Omega} = g \},$$
and the Dirichlet energy
$$E(u) = \int_\Omega |\nabla u|^2\, dx.$$
Let $C(\overline\Omega)$ denote the space of continuous maps on $\overline\Omega$. Assume that $H^1_g(\Omega; S^2) \cap C(\overline\Omega)$ is nonempty, and consider the variational problem
$$\inf\{ E(u) : u \in H^1_g(\Omega; S^2) \cap C(\overline\Omega) \}.$$
Is this infimum attained by some map $u \in H^1_g(\Omega; S^2) \cap C(\overline\Omega)$?
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the Dirichlet energy infimum, taken over continuous $H^1$ maps from a 3D domain into $S^2$ with prescribed boundary data, is attained is a long-standing open problem connected to work of Hardt–Lin and Bethuel–Brezis–Coron. Related results address the Lavrentiev gap phenomenon and relaxed energies, but no source found establishes attainment or non-attainment in this continuous class.

status_evidence.title: The Lavrentiev gap phenomenon for harmonic maps into spheres
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the gap between energies of general H^1 maps into S^2 and those of smoother classes.
status_evidence.claim: Related works study whether minimization over restricted (smooth/continuous) classes yields different infima, but attainment in the continuous class remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: The Dirichlet energy of mappings with values into the sphere
status_evidence.snippet: Bethuel–Brezis–Coron study relaxed energies and density problems for S^2-valued maps.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational work on minimization of Dirichlet energy of S^2-valued maps in 3D, without resolving attainment in the continuous subclass.
